faq.achievementsA: {total}: {common} common milestones, {creative} creative challenges and {special} truly unexpected specials. Each one awards XP, BadgesCoins and points, plus a sparkle badge in your profile's achievement showcase.
faq.badgesA: Yes! Sync your badges after logging in — every newly unlocked badge pays +1,000 XP and +500 BadgesCoins and appears in the live feed.
faq.badgesQ: Do my Twitch badges give XP?
faq.blogA: New badge drops, jackpot wins and site features are announced on the blog with view counts and emoji reactions. New drops and jackpot wins are announced there automatically.
faq.blogQ: Where can I read more about features?
faq.coinsA: BadgesCoins are bet in all 13 arcade games, paid as attempt costs for coin heists, and earned from daily bonuses, badge unlocks, achievements and game wins.
faq.coinsQ: What do I do with BadgesCoins?
faq.dailyA: Claim it once per day in the arcade hub: +10 XP and +50 BadgesCoins. Consecutive days build a streak that adds up to +50 bonus XP and +250 bonus BadgesCoins per day.
faq.dailyQ: How does the daily login bonus work?
faq.dataA: Badges sync from the official Twitch catalog, owner statistics come from public community trackers, and the badges you own are resolved live from your public Twitch profile. BadgesCoins and XP are this site's own playful economy and have no monetary value.
faq.dataQ: Where does my data come from?
faq.fairA: Yes, and it is built to stay that way. Every game outcome is decided on the server, never in your browser. Games are capped at 100 XP per day so nobody can farm XP in a loop, view counters ignore repeat reloads from the same IP for five minutes, and stealing has both a per-victim cooldown and an hourly limit. The whole economy is public on the statistics page, so you can always check the numbers yourself.
faq.fairQ: Is the XP and BadgesCoin system fair?
faq.feedA: Every single XP gain: daily bonuses, badge unlocks, wheel spins, game rounds, achievements, level-ups, steals, coin rains and jackpot wins — from all collectors, updating every few seconds.
faq.feedQ: What appears in the live feed?
faq.freeA: Yes — log in with Twitch, sync your badges and everything is playable for free. No purchases, no pay-to-win.
faq.gamesA: All luck-based outcomes (slots, roulette, wheel, coin flips, blackjack, scratch, tower) are rolled on the server and cannot be manipulated. Skill games (shooting, memory, catching) check scores server-side with caps.
faq.levelsA: Level 1 starts at 0 XP. Each level needs 100 + (level-1) x 50 XP — level 100 totals 252,450 XP. Every level has a unique sparkle-animated level badge in your profile that is toggleable in the profile customizer.
faq.profileA: 36 settings: 21 common (colors, fonts, banner, card style, frames, privacy toggles, social links) and 15 creative extras (aura, particle background, rainbow name, 3D tilt, pixel avatar, achievement ticker and more).
faq.rainA: A coin rain is a small gift: any visitor can trigger one coin rain per day on your profile, giving you +1 coin with a little animation.
faq.stealA: Open another collector's profile and attempt a heist. The victim sets the attempt price and maximum haul; the success chance (20 to 80 percent) shifts with the level difference between you two. Failed attempts pay the price to the victim.
faq.stealCostA: In your settings you can disable stealing entirely, set the attempt price and cap the maximum haul. A flood check limits heists to one per victim per 5 minutes and 6 per hour.
faq.stealCostQ: Can I protect myself from thieves?
faq.subtitle: The complete guide to the gamification system.
faq.title: FAQ — Everything about XP, BadgesCoins and games
faq.turboA: Yes — one wheel slot holds a free Twitch Turbo subscription with a win probability of exactly 0.00000001 (1 : 100,000,000), alongside 5,000 XP and 50,000 BadgesCoins.
faq.turboQ: Is the Twitch Turbo jackpot real?
faq.visitorsA: Your profile shows the total view count plus the latest visitors as avatars. All view counters use a 5-minute per-IP reload block so refreshing does not inflate numbers.
faq.whatA: Every logged-in collector earns XP and BadgesCoins: daily login (+10 XP, +50 BadgesCoins), unlocking Twitch badges (+1,000 XP, +500 BadgesCoins each), achievements (up to +5,000 XP) and games (+2 XP per round, +10 per win, capped at 100 XP per day). XP raises your level from 1 to 100; BadgesCoins are the currency for games and heists.
faq.whatQ: What is the XP and coin system?
faq.wheelA: Once per day. Prizes range from +25 XP (most common) to +5,000 XP (very rare), each with bonus BadgesCoins.
faq.wheelQ: How often can I spin the Wheel of Fortune?
faq.xpA: Daily login +10 XP plus +5 per streak day (max +50). Each synced Twitch badge +1,000 XP. Achievements pay up to 5,000 XP. Games pay +2 XP per round and +10 XP per win, capped at 100 XP per day to prevent farming. The Wheel of Fortune pays 25 to 5,000 XP per spin.
